text:
maria: AM async check-in — kicked off a targeted prewarm in eu-west-1 for the model-reservoir job. 6/8 GPU lanes came up READY, 2 failed to bind (attach timeout). Saw logs with 'failed to attach device: timeout' on the kubelet side. Blocker: need a quick AZ quota bump to reach the 12-lane target for the afternoon surge. Today I will open the quota request and triage the two failed nodes.

jake: can you paste the pod/node attach logs? if it's nvlink/driver mismatch we should see it in dmesg or kubelet events. also, share the node names so i can SSH.

maria: logs snippet: ```
May 10 07:12:34 node-az1 kubelet: E attach: failed to attach device: timeout after 30s
May 10 07:12:36 node-az1 kernel: nvidia: probe failed: -110
May 10 07:12:39 node-az1 kubelet: Warning FailedMount 
```
I uncordoned them so they can be re-tried. node names: euw1-node-214, euw1-node-215.

kira: heads-up — I already bumped the spot buffer in us-west2 by +2 for expected load later. eu-west-1 headroom looks tight; we should avoid shifting more lanes there until quota is approved.

sam: opened PR 678 to add an extra retry on device attach (2s backoff x3) in the daemonset init — @maria can you take a quick look? should reduce transient failures from nvlink flakiness.

maria: reviewing PR 678 now. also opened INFRA-912 for the quota bump (details + expected p50/p95 delta). link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INFRA-912

ops-bot: [deploy-bot] Prewarm job started: region=eu-west-1 model=model-reservoir v=2 run_id=run-342 status=running :rocket:

jake: quick capacity question — if we push from 8 -> 12 lanes in eu-west-1, what do we expect for p50 latency and tail behavior?

maria: rough numbers posted to INFRA-912: p50 ~ +15% vs baseline due to longer packing, throughput +2.2x, p95 might increase more if we hit noisy neighbors. i'll add a short perf sample to the ticket after the next successful prewarm.

kira: can someone update the node-labels mapping doc? noticed eu-west1 labels got swapped during the last infra churn; I left a comment in the docs repo.

maria: thanks all. blocker cleared once quota approved and sam's retry PR passes e2e. i'll ping @oncall if we need escalation. :thumbsup:
